releases.notes:
Macless 1.0.1 for Minecraft 1.16.1 and 26.3. This is a prerelease candidate for moderator review. It is not approved for submitted speedruns.

## Source and review materials

[Permanent source revision](https://github.com/riye-prog/macless/tree/290caad33745eae33596267eb0732a682686f046)

[Review notes and submission draft](https://github.com/riye-prog/macless/blob/290caad33745eae33596267eb0732a682686f046/approval/readme.md), [pending rulings](https://github.com/riye-prog/macless/blob/290caad33745eae33596267eb0732a682686f046/approval/rulings.json), [exact binary identities](https://github.com/riye-prog/macless/blob/290caad33745eae33596267eb0732a682686f046/approval/artifacts.json), and [build setup and dependencies](https://github.com/riye-prog/macless/blob/290caad33745eae33596267eb0732a682686f046/approval/build.json) are public. The source license and dependency notices are included.

## Downloads

Choose the JAR matching your Minecraft version. Both JARs include macOS arm64 and x64, Windows x64, and Linux x64 and arm64 natives. Fabric API is not bundled or required.

The multiplatform ZIP contains both JARs, source, licenses, exact hashes, screenshots, logs, and validation records. The gallery ZIP contains the HTML gallery and its screenshots. `checksums.json` identifies the native libraries and Windows capture helper as well as the JARs. `release-assets.json` identifies every separately uploaded asset.
